root = Stack([searchCard, transactionsCard])

$search = ""

transactions = Query("host_listTransactions", { search: $search }, { data: [], total: 0 }, 10)

searchCard = Card([
    TextContent("Search Transactions", "large-heavy"),
    FormControl("Search by merchant or descriptor", Input("search", "Enter search term...", "text", null, $search))
])

transactionsCard = Card([
    TextContent("Recent Transactions", "large-heavy"),
    @Count(transactions.data) > 0 ? Table([
        Col("Merchant", transactions.data.merchant),
        Col("Descriptor", transactions.data.descriptor),
        Col("Amount", @Each(transactions.data, "tx", TextContent("$" + tx.amount, "default")), "number"),
        Col("Category", transactions.data.category),
        Col("Date", @Each(transactions.data, "tx", TextContent(@First(tx.timestamp.split("T")), "default")))
    ]) : TextContent("No transactions found for '" + $search + "'. Try a different search term.")
])
